study: Final Scientific Closure — P1 Deployment Boundary
scope_notes: Persistent reputation is capability-specific; worker-capability trajectories are the primary coverage unit.
The lean artifact does not retain participant-level first-calibration timestamps, so exact worker-level waiting time is not claimed.
Reference-provider acquisition latency is external to the MPC path and was not measured.
Selector hiddenness does not imply that task content hides application-level verifiability cues.
SQLite-WAL experiments validate persistence/replay semantics at component level, not distributed failover.
The 4+3+3 VM layout is a performance topology, not ten independent administrative trust domains.
